text: ポケモンしょうぶで　にげだそうと　するとは　なにごとじゃ！

structure.jp: にげだそうと　するとは
structure.en: that you try to run away
what is the meaning of this!

patterns.name: 〜(よ)うとする
patterns.span: にげだそうと　する
patterns.explanation: The う-form plus とする means trying or about to do something. にげだそうとする = 'try to run away'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a plain verb picks out a surprising thing, with disapproval here. するとは = 'to think you'd do (that)'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is an old-man form of だ. なにごとじゃ = 'what is this!'.
